parts:
for a CSV dataset, try something like this:

# ui.R

fileInput("dataset", "Choose a CSV file from your local drive",
  accept = c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain') )

# server.R

df <- read.csv(input$dataset$datapath)

you can add options to read.csv, you can read other types of datasets in a similar way (though xlsx is a mess).
